dispatch status shows open escalation kinds and ages (ESC-V0-009) with tests.

body: The owner accepted #502 on 2026-10-05 with qualification NOT_RUN; V1-0699 completes on that basis. Delivered: typed escalation writer, ESCALATION_PENDING holds, claim delivery of answers (ESC-V0-005), bounded infrastructure retry (ESC-V0-007), typed park classification with unreadable material held, not counted as progress (ESC-V0-008), and receipt-audit binding of the LEASE-stage escalation events including the 256 KiB answer capacity (ESC-V0-010 on the LEASE route). The orchestrator, under the owner's delegation, accepted the delivered LEASE route for this closure without amending ESC-V0-010 text and kept the fail-closed defaults: a missing infrastructureRetry policy means retry disabled; no retry-state reset command; the Codex round-2 checkpoint-tail reference comparison declined; park classification matches only the holder recorded in the audited source. Tracked here: (1) reconcile ESC-V0-010 (move to the 501 MUTATE slot or amend the requirement to the LEASE route) with a distinct typed-event stage if needed; (2) ESC-V0-009 open request kinds and ages in dispatch status; (3) a live dispatcher and compiled-binary witness; (4) interrupted paired publication at each artifact; (5) forged-history regressions for the currentClaim attempt-not-current and reservation-mismatch branches; (6) an operator retry-state reset, if wanted; (7) make gate. See docs/specs/corvint-tasks-escalations-v0.md and docs/build-log/2026-10-05-issue502-escalation-retry-and-material.md.
title: Typed escalations: ESC-V0-010 route reconciliation, ESC-V0-009 status kinds and ages, live dispatcher witness (issue #502 follow-up)
